ambient_events: A wave hits the armour on the sea side and comes over the wall as spray.
The light on the head comes round to its blink and goes out again.
A gull stands on a block out of the wind and watches the water.
Inside the mole the water barely moves.
description: A rubble mole runs out from the beach, rock under a concrete cap wide enough for two to pass. Armour blocks are piled down both sides. The sea is on the left and flat water on the right.
name: The West Mole
